svg.text: The same inbox preview in four palettes, light, dark and pure black. Colours are previews; the real ones come from the generated scheme.
Default. Calm green on warm paper.
Dark mode keeps hue, lowers chroma,
Dark mode. Text and icons keep 4.5 to 1.
Dark mode. Surfaces step up in tone for
containers stay a few tone steps lighter
so the list is still visible.
Croft wireframes · green = primary action · wax red = destructive · amber = star and snooze · blue = read state · wax tags = behaviour notes
